name: Priya Sharma
bio:
Priya Sharma’s journey into motorsport began unconventionally, not through a family legacy but a fascination sparked by a local go-karting track. Initially drawn to the mechanical intricacies, she quickly realized her organizational skills could be invaluable behind the scenes. After earning a degree in Logistics and Supply Chain Management, Priya immersed herself in the racing world, starting as an intern for a small Formula Ford team. Her meticulous planning and problem-solving abilities led to rapid promotions, handling increasingly complex logistical challenges.

Now at Trackhouse Racing, Priya approaches her role with a blend of precision and pragmatism. She believes that seamless logistics are the invisible foundation of any successful racing team. Her focus on anticipating potential disruptions and proactively developing contingency plans sets her apart. She is known for her ability to juggle multiple priorities under immense pressure, ensuring that the team has the right resources at the right place and time.

Priya's demanding nature stems from her unwavering commitment to excellence. She is driven by a deep-seated belief that every detail matters, and that meticulous planning can make the difference between victory and defeat. She constantly seeks to optimize processes and improve efficiency, fostering a culture of continuous improvement within the logistics department.

physical.hairStyle: Long, thick hair usually tied in a neat braid
physical.description: Priya is of average height with a determined gaze and a practical demeanor.

quirks: Insists on using a color-coded spreadsheet for all logistical planning.
Has a peculiar habit of double-checking every shipment manifest, even those she personally prepared.
Always carries a small notebook filled with checklists and flowcharts.
